follow-up time: Participants were surveyed postpartum during their hospital stay.
cohort: Pregnant women aged 18 years or older admitted for planned cesarean delivery at one of two delivery units
finding: While the study did not find significant differences in maternal or newborn outcomes, including maternal satisfaction, the family-centered cesarean was significantly associated with earlier skin-to-skin contact.
mod_finding: The family-centered cesarean was significantly associated with earlier skin-to-skin contact compared to the traditional method.
